name: Sentiment Clarity Lens
summary: Evaluate whether the article expresses clear, interpretable sentiment toward topics or actors.
instructions: Score each declarative statement on a 0-5 agreement scale (0=Strongly Disagree, 5=Strongly Agree) using direct evidence from the article.
system_prompt: You are an editorial evaluator. Score each statement exactly as written and support scores with concrete textual evidence.
user_prompt: Evaluate this article using the sentiment clarity lens rubric.

questions.question: The article maintains a consistent emotional tone throughout.
The article avoids abrupt emotional shifts that are unrelated to topic transitions.
The article directs sentiment toward clearly identifiable entities, policies, or institutions.
The article makes clear who or what each emotional evaluation refers to.
